checks.result: Reviewed revision/dependency/acceptance/evidence/blocker ordering; immutable selected evidence records and criterion-to-ID bindings; exact-ID database checks; report file and hash rereads before writing and finalization; YAML preservation and evidence namespace collisions; completed source projection before the work.completed receipt; claim release sharing the final transaction. After-write failures retain recovery when actual source still matches the planned bytes. This is an implementation review by the implementing agent, not independent business acceptance.

limitations: Feature-local verification only; centralized regression, security, eight real-client business scenarios and ten benchmarks remain scheduled in later work items. No release or E4 acceptance is claimed.

Completion checks supplied evidence metadata and actual versioned report contents. It does not execute the report command, judge natural-language acceptance quality or establish independent reviewer identity. A supplied source SHA does not prove the live checkout is clean.

Completion uses local YAML source writeback. Evidence reports must be registered local files within allowed roots; source references with unknown level cannot qualify. The explicit minimum is at least locally_verified.

Report producer metadata is hash-bound but not interpreted as extra authority. Individual selected reports are limited to 1 MiB; completion input and proposal are limited to 64 KiB with at most 100 distinct evidence records.

Filesystem rename is not a CAS against an unrelated external editor. Actual source and report bytes are reread at critical boundaries; pending write receipts retain before/after snapshots and require explicit recovery.
